Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used a Strep-tag based affinity purification (AP-MS) to identify the interactome of ANP32e. Quantification was performed using the MaxLFQ algorithm in MaxQuant.

scope: We used an affinity purification mass spectrometry (AP-MS) approach to investigate whether the protein interactome of ANP32e changes during the cell cycle.
AP of Strep–ANP32e was performed from nucleoplasmic subcellular fractions. This was followed by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) to identify the ANP32e–protein interactants
Protein complexes were eluted from the beads using two successive elutions by addition of 100 µL wash buffer supplemented with 4 mM desthiobiotin
subcellular_fraction: AP of Strep–ANP32e was performed from nucleoplasmic subcellular fractions.
A total of 3.25 mg of nuclear extract (measured using the Bio-Rad protein assay) was used per reaction in pulldown buffer

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material affinity-purified (Strep-tag) from nuclear extracts/nucleoplasmic fractions.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary proteomics experiment (AP-MS) focuses on the comparison of the ANP32e interactome between G1 and G2-M phases of the cell cycle. While the study also uses siRNA depletion of ANP32e, the MS data described in the results and PRIDE metadata specifically pertains to the cell-cycle synchronization comparison using Strep-tagged ANP32e.
